keyEvents.text: Amir Berchil (Guiseley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Charlie Carter (Sutton United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joe Knight (Sutton United) is shown the yellow card.
Oliver Brown (Guiseley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jake Taylor (Sutton United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jack Tinker (Guiseley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Guiseley 1, Sutton United 0. Jordan Thewlis (Guiseley) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
